caption: The drawing depicts a bird perched on a branch, with leaves extending from the branch. The bird is predominantly blue with areas of black, white, red, and brown detailing on its body and wings, and it has a long, pointed yellow beak. The branch is brown and the leaves are green, with two main clusters of leaves depicted above and below the branch. The background features a checkered pattern of squares in various colors including red, green, blue, yellow, gray, tan, and orange. At the bottom of the image, the name "OCTAVIE DUPART" is written in uppercase red letters. The bird and branch are centrally positioned, while the multicolored checkerboard pattern forms a border around them. The image has a textured appearance, suggesting it is based on embroidery or needlepoint work.
title: Sampler
